blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – A 40-year-old man was stabbed to death by his 20-year-old son following a heated argument inside their home in Lipa City, Batangas on Sunday night (November 8), police said. In a report on Monday, the Police Regional Office 4-A said the father and son, who were both reportedly under the influence of liquor, were having dinner at their residence in Barangay Banay-Banay at around 8:30 p.m. when an argument broke out.
